hero.subtitle: ACSE AI resolves service requests, flags billing exceptions, and creates field actions — fully automated, 24/7.

platform.heading: One AI platform for your entire utility operation
platform.subtitle: ACSE AI integrates with your existing systems to automate inbound customer requests, billing exceptions, and field service orders — reducing manual effort across every department.

customerService.title: Customer service AI
customerService.body: Resolves start/stop/transfer, account updates, and outage inquiries end-to-end across any channel.

billing.title: Billing automation
billing.body: Monitors the billing queue continuously, flags anomalies, and initiates exception workflows in real time.

field.title: Field operations
field.body: Creates and tracks meter reads, investigations, and service orders — and keeps customers updated.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.body: Plugs into your existing C2M application and systems of record. Runs on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.

promises.handleService: Handles start, stop, and transfer of service without agent involvement
promises.autopay: Proactively contacts customers with expiring autopay before a disruption
promises.fieldActivities: Automatically creates field activities for meter investigations and reads
promises.billingAnomalies: Monitors billing anomalies and flags exceptions in real time

useCases.heading: Everything your customers need — handled automatically
useCases.subtitle: From routine account updates to emergency reports, ACSE AI resolves requests end-to-end without putting customers on hold.
useCases.tryAll: Try any of these with the assistant

startService.title: Start / Stop / Transfer service
startService.body: Customers initiate, end, or transfer service through any channel — fully automated.

paymentArrangement.title: Payment extension & arrangement
paymentArrangement.body: AI negotiates and logs payment plans based on account history and policy rules.

updateContact.title: Account information updates
updateContact.body: Update phone numbers, add account holders, and correct mailing addresses instantly.

reportOutage.title: Outage inquiries
reportOutage.body: Real-time outage status delivered to customers without agent escalation.

reportLeak.title: Emergency leak & main break
reportLeak.body: Captures and routes emergency reports for low/no water, leaks, and main breaks.

highBill.title: High bill investigation
highBill.body: AI reviews consumption history and creates field activities for meter anomalies.

meterRead.title: Meter read creation
meterRead.body: Automatically creates meter reads when accounts reach their billing window end.

autopayOutreach.title: Autopay expiration outreach
autopayOutreach.body: Proactively contacts customers when autopay is expiring to prevent interruption.

newService.title: New service application
newService.body: Guides customers through new service applications and tracks submission status.

billing.heading: Catch billing exceptions before they become problems
billing.subtitle: ACSE AI monitors your billing queue continuously, flags anomalies, and takes action — so nothing slips through.

usageAlerts.title: High / low usage alerts
usageAlerts.body: Automatically flags accounts with usage outside expected thresholds and initiates investigation workflows.

maxBill.title: Max bill threshold
maxBill.body: Prevents billing errors by catching accounts that exceed maximum bill limits before statements go out.

zeroReads.title: 3 consecutive zero reads
zeroReads.body: Detects three straight zero-consumption reads and creates a service order for field verification.

schedule.title: Read & bill schedule
schedule.body: Creates and manages meter read and billing schedules, ensuring accounts are billed on time every cycle.

orderStatus.title: Service & work order status
orderStatus.body: Tracks open orders and updates customers and dispatchers automatically as status changes.
